title: "The Utah Pictures" comic page: Delbert Newhouse films UFOs near Tremonton, Utah (p. 20)
description: Comic-book illustrated page titled "THE UTAH PICTURES," telling how Navy Warrant Officer Delbert C. Newhouse, driving on Highway 30 seven miles north of Tremonton, Utah on July 2, 1952, saw "a group of round, extremely bright objects moving west at a very high speed." Panels show his car beside a Tremonton road sign, Newhouse filming with a Bell and Howell movie camera, and an audience viewing the film at a photo-interpretation center. A text panel lists the laboratories' conclusions, ending "6. The sighting could not be explained by any conventional answer." A handwritten note at top reads "Tremonton Case."
